titleText.noteEn: Both title attributes are preserved exactly. The Spanish raster localizes GATES as PUERTAS, CLICK as CLIC, and the final WOOOOOOO as YUUUUUUU. Vision omitted the seat numbers and letters, exit triangles, arrow, bracketing asterisks, and final shout, and misread PUERTAS as HERTAS.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Seleccione politely tells one person addressed as usted to choose something. It is the formal command of seleccionar.
Puerta usually means a door. At an airport, puerta also means the numbered gate through which passengers board a flight; puertas is the plural.

example.es: Las puertas de embarque están a la derecha.
example.en: The boarding gates are on the right.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: The repeated u letters show that the vowel is held for a long time. Written sound effects can vary in spelling and length.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: selección de asiento · diagrama del avión · clic en la cabina
cardDefinitions.questionEn: What visual mistake creates the joke?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: The passenger treats the cockpit drawn on an airline seat map as a selectable seat, so clicking it puts her in the pilot's position.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Real airline diagrams show the aircraft around the passenger seats but do not make the cockpit selectable. The final panel turns the interface click into a literal assignment to fly the plane. The title text extends the same absurd interface rule to the wing.
